post.text:
NFL Schedule News 🇫🇷

The Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints will face off in the inaugural NFL Paris Game at the Stade de France, per sources.

The first-ever NFL game in France is set for October 25th - Week 7, with kickoff at 9:30 AM EST. https://t.co/M8JTkJtTpI

description.description: A graphic promoting an NFL international game in Paris scheduled for October 25, Week 7 of the 2026 season. The image features the Pittsburgh Steelers logo on a yellow background and the New Orleans Saints logo on a gold background. Centered at the top is the official NFL Paris Game 2026 logo.
description.ocrText: OCT. 25 NFL 2026 PARIS GAME WEEK 7 Steelers Unaffiliated with the NFL Ozzy
